# A test reaches into a component built at run time on every target, through
# a named instance and through one copy of one: a trigger, a null test, a
# one-way prop read, a var read, a method call and the instance's own event
# (app.sngl), through a component rendered at several sites and through two
# instances (sites.sngl), and on html a node of a copy whose id another loop's
# component renders too (twice.sngl). testdata/test_reach_runtime_instance.txtar
# and test_reach_runtime_instance_sites.txtar are the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none sites.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html sites.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go sites.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go sites.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go sites.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin sites.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html twice.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    func reset() {
        hits = 0
    }
    text #shown(value="[{label}:{hits}]")
    button #hit(text="hit", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
    })
    if hits >= 2 {
        text #done(value="done")
    }
}

component tile(label string, @tapped(n int)) node {
    var taps = 0
    text #face(value="<{label}:{taps}>")
    button #tap(text="tap", @click {
        taps = taps + 1
        tapped(taps)
    })
    if taps >= 2 {
        text #fin(value="fin")
    }
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    var names list[string] = ["a", "b"]
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        if show {
            badge #b(label="one")
        }
        for var i, n = names {
            tile #r(label="{i}{n}", @tapped(k) {
                log = log + "{n}{k};"
            })
        }
        button #toggle(text="t", @click {
            show = !show
        })
    }
}

func testReachesOneInstance(t Test, c main) {
    if c.b != null {
        t.assert(c.b.done == null)
        c.b.hit.click()
        t.assert(c.b.hits == 1)
        t.assert(c.b.label == "one")
        t.assert(c.b.shown.value == "[one:1]")
        c.b.hit.click()
        t.assert(c.b.done != null)
        c.b.reset()
        t.assert(c.b.hits == 0)
    } else {
        t.assert(false)
    }
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.b == null)
}

func testReachesOneCopy(t Test, c main) {
    if c.r[1] != null {
        t.assert(c.r[1].fin == null)
        c.r[1].tap.click()
        t.assert(c.r[1].taps == 1)
        t.assert(c.r[0].taps == 0)
        t.assert(c.r[1].label == "1b")
        t.assert(c.r[1].face.value == "<1b:1>")
        c.r[1].tap.click()
        t.assert(c.r[1].fin != null)
        t.assert(c.r[0].fin == null)
        t.assert(c.log == "b1;b2;")
    } else {
        t.assert(false)
    }
}

func testFiresACopysEvent(t Test, c main) {
    c.r[0].tapped(7)
    t.assert(c.log == "a7;")
    t.assert(c.r[0].taps == 0)
}

window {
    main
}
-- sites.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    text #shown(value="[{label}:{hits}]")
    button #hit(text="hit", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
    })
    if hits >= 2 {
        text #done(value="done")
    }
}

component panel node {
    var open = true
    vbox {
        if open {
            badge #inner(label="in")
        }
        badge #fixed(label="fixed")
    }
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    var names list[string] = ["a", "b"]
    vbox {
        if show {
            badge #b(label="one")
        }
        for var n = names {
            badge #r(label=n)
        }
        panel #p
    }
}

func testEachSiteIsItsOwn(t Test, c main) {
    if c.b != null {
        c.b.hit.click()
        t.assert(c.b.hits == 1)
    }
    if c.r[1] != null {
        c.r[1].hit.click()
        c.r[1].hit.click()
        t.assert(c.r[1].hits == 2)
        t.assert(c.r[1].done != null)
        t.assert(c.r[0].done == null)
        t.assert(c.r[1].shown.value == "[b:2]")
    }
    if c.b != null {
        t.assert(c.b.done == null)
        t.assert(c.b.hits == 1)
    }
}

func testReachesThroughTwoInstances(t Test, c main) {
    if c.p.inner != null {
        c.p.inner.hit.click()
        t.assert(c.p.inner.hits == 1)
        t.assert(c.p.inner.label == "in")
        t.assert(c.p.fixed.hits == 0)
    } else {
        t.assert(false)
    }
    c.p.fixed.hit.click()
    t.assert(c.p.fixed.hits == 1)
    t.assert(c.p.fixed.shown.value == "[fixed:1]")
}

window {
    main
}
-- twice.sngl --
import "sngl:test/browser"
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component other(label string) node {
    var seen = 0
    text #shown(value="other {label}:{seen}")
}

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    text #shown(value="[{label}:{hits}]")
}

component main node {
    var names list[string] = ["a"]
    for var n = names {
        other #o(label=n)
    }
    for var n = names {
        badge #b(label=n)
    }
}

func testTheSecondLoopsCopy(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(browser.text(c.b[0].shown) == "[a:0]")
}

window {
    main
}
